places-arco-i-central-e-de-santonje-2.story: A 243 km round trip from Calasparra - roughly 4 h 11 in the saddle. On the way it passes Abrigo de Zaén II, Central E. de Santonje and back through Abrigo de Zaén II. The highest point is about 1,300 m. The line favours views over speed.
